title: MAD Speech: Measures of Acoustic Diversity of Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the representational diversity of generated speech by measuring the proportion of female versus male voices. This is done by encoding audio with a generic speech representation (SpeechSim), applying a gender-specific projection model, and aggregating the embeddings using mean pairwise cosine dissimilarity or Vendi Score.

Evaluating the diversity of regional accents in generated speech by computing the entropy of the distribution of different accent classes using an accent-specialized projection model trained on top of continuous speech embeddings.
Measuring mode collapse and speaker diversity by tracking the number of distinct speaker voices within sets of generated audio utterances using specialized voice projection models.
Measuring the acoustic diversity of expressed emotions in synthesized speech by computing the entropy of the distribution of emotion classes using specialized speech representation embeddings.
Evaluating the diversity of generated acoustic scenes by measuring the number of different background noise classes present in the audio outputs using specific projection models.
